# Core triggers

![Adding a trigger: on the Actions page, click + Trigger and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-trigger-picker.png)

## Application started

Runs once each time Cuebot finishes starting up. Good for setting your variables, switching a scene or saying hello every time you open Cuebot.

<small>Type id: `core.appStarted`</small>

## Cron schedule

Runs on a clock schedule that you write, like every 15 minutes or every day at 8 pm. It uses your computer's local time and is separate from the Timers page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Cron expression** | Five parts with spaces between: minute, hour, day of the month, month, day of the week. A * means every. "*/15 * * * *" is every 15 minutes, "0 20 * * *" is every day at 20:00. Starts as: `0 * * * *`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%expression%` | The schedule text that matched |
| `%triggeredAt%` | The date and time (to the minute) when it ran |

<small>Type id: `core.cron`</small>

## Profile started

Runs each time Cuebot finishes starting on a profile (a persona), also right after you switch to it. Good for getting that persona's stream ready: switch the OBS scene collection, load the VTube Studio model, set the stream title.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%profile%` | The name of the profile that started, like "Night Owl" |
| `%profileId%` | Its folder name, like "night-owl" |
| `%previousProfile%` | The profile Cuebot switched from, or empty when Cuebot just started |
| `%previousProfileId%` | The folder name of the profile Cuebot switched from, or empty |

<small>Type id: `core.profileStarted`</small>

## Profile stopping

Runs just before Cuebot switches to another profile. Cuebot waits for these actions to finish (at most 10 seconds), then opens again on the other profile. Good for saying goodbye in chat or putting OBS back the way it was.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%profile%` | The name of the profile that is closing |
| `%profileId%` | Its folder name |
| `%nextProfile%` | The name of the profile Cuebot is switching to |
| `%nextProfileId%` | Its folder name |

<small>Type id: `core.profileStopping`</small>

## Timer

Runs each time one of your timers goes off. You make timers on the Timers page. Good for a repeating reminder like "follow the channel" every 20 minutes.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Timer** | The name of the timer, exactly as it is on the Timers page, like "Social links". Leave it empty to run for every timer. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timerName%` | The name of the timer that went off |
| `%interval%` | How many seconds the timer waits between runs |
| `%chatLines%` | How many chat messages came in since the timer last ran |
| `%timerId%` | The timer's internal id (rarely needed) |

<small>Type id: `core.timer`</small>
